page.overview:
Who is Bhashiva?

Bhashiva, also called the "Desert Tigress", is the current ruling White Tiger of the Tiger Warriors, a group of Tigermen mercenaries who have sworn service to the Iron Dragon Zhao Ming, the ruler of the Western Provinces of Grand Cathay.

The "White Tiger" is the title and role of a legendary leader among those Tigermen now known as the Tiger Warriors who rejected the worship of Chaos through their sheer nobility and the leadership of the Tiger God Kamau, left their homeland in Ind and settled within the borders of Grand Cathay, forming a mercenary force that now serves under the command of the Iron Dragon. The White Tiger is ranked as one of the lords of the city of Shang-Yang, the capital of the Western Provinces.

Like all the White Tigers before her, Bhashiva leads the "Tiger Court", the Tiger Warriors' governing council that is located in Shang-Yang.

The White Tiger possesses the magical ability to teleport short distances across a battlefield allowing her to lend her martial prowess to where it is most needed on the field, or to instantly disengage when a fight is going poorly to strike at a more vulnerable point along the line of battle.
